answer: Unique oscillator attestation binds each identity to a dedicated crystal's unpredictable timing jitter. Enrollment requires a walnut-sized sealed timing module whose signed drift trace is checked against prior samples and external beacons. At each dawn boundary, the verifier issues a fresh challenge; a single operator cannot clone one module's microscopic manufacturing variation across many agent identities. Each fake identity therefore costs a separate physical module plus its attestation fee and maintenance.
